# oden_plugin_rs

> Rust wrapper for the Oden plugin C API. Write Oden plugins in Rust against a
> safe, idiomatic API.

Latest release: 49.3.0

API methods live as inherent methods on the `*Params` structs (`InitParams`,
`UpdateParams`, `GuiParams`, ...). Call them directly on the `api` value passed
to each `OdenPlugin` method; you do not need to import the `*Api` traits, and
importing them only yields unused-import warnings.

## Add the crate

```toml
# Latest
oden_plugin_rs = { git = "https://github.com/voysys/oden_plugin_rs", branch = "master" }

# Pinned to a release
oden_plugin_rs = { git = "https://github.com/voysys/oden_plugin_rs", tag = "v49.3.0" }
```

## Hello world

```rust
use oden_plugin_rs::{
    math::{Vec3, Vec4},
    register_plugin, GuiParams, InitParams, OdenPlugin, ShutdownParams, UpdateParams,
};

struct State;

impl OdenPlugin for State {
    fn init(_api: &InitParams) -> Self {
        State
    }

    fn shutdown(self, _api: &ShutdownParams) {}

    fn update(&mut self, api: &UpdateParams) {
        api.im_draw_add_text(
            "Hello World!",
            Vec3::xyz(-1.0, 0.0, -2.0),
            Vec3::xyz(0.0, 0.3, 0.0),
            Vec3::xyz(1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            Vec4::rgba(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1.0),
            0,
        );
    }

    fn gui(&mut self, api: &GuiParams) {
        api.label("Hello World!");
    }
}

register_plugin!(
    "Hello World from Rust",
    "185d4603-e803-4fa2-9f56-266782cf2e98",
    State
);
```
